Incident Bot: paging: multiple model artifact fetch failures from hf.co (429/503) observed across hosted inference pools — affecting cold starts and model downloads. triage channel = #incidents. paging @Anna (oncall) :rotating_light:
Anna (oncall): seeing spike in 5xx on model-fetch metric. initial alert at 1778456789. is this HF-side or our proxy?
Miguel (sre): logs show repeated 429 responses from https://huggingface.co/models/.../resolve/main/pytorch_model.bin, with retry loop hitting backoff ceiling. sample from node-03: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests - x-ratelimit-remaining: 0`
Liz (mlops): confirming. bundling a short log snippet: ```
[2026-03-?? ??/??:??:??] fetch model=redwood/gpt-q params={ver: 2026-03-01}
curl -sS -D - "https://huggingface.co/redwood/gpt-q/resolve/main/pytorch_model.bin" -o /tmp/model.bin
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry 1 -> sleeping 1s
Retry 2 -> sleeping 2s
Retry 3 -> sleeping 4s
Error: exhausted retries
```
Anna (oncall): customer impact? any user-facing errors?
Customer Ops (Jane): several customers reported increased latency and failures for first-invocation requests. one SSO'd enterprise saw transient 503s in logs. they're asking if it's our infra or hf outage.
Miguel (sre): impact scope: ~15% of cold starts failing to load model within 30s across hosted pools in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. warm sessions unaffected. Rate-limited downloads causing prolonged cold start and request timeouts. No data leakage.
Liz (mlops): immediate mitigations I can flip now: 1) enable internal mirror fallback (S3 mirror) for model artifacts for affected model families, 2) increase aggressive caching TTL for artifact blobs, 3) reduce concurrent model-fetch parallelism per node to avoid stampeding herd. Recommend doing 1+3 now.
Anna (oncall): do it. post the exact commands / config toggle. add a brief note for customers.
Liz (mlops): toggling mirror for redwood/gpt-q -> config: ```
# feature flag: use_artifact_mirror=true
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-q","use_mirror":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```
Liz (mlops): also lowering max_concurrent_model_fetches from 6 -> 2 on hosted runtime nodes via SSM runbook. executing now.
Miguel (sre): adjusting client-side retry policy: switch to jittered exponential backoff with max_retries=5 and disable immediate retries for 429s (respect Retry-After when present). patching rollout via config release.
Incident Bot: oncall handoff scheduled in 45m to @Oliver (oncall-next). Anna acknowledged.
Hugging Face Support: (automated) we've opened a ticket with HF SRE. Ticket ID HF-87612. HF SRE investigating upstream CDN rate limiting on artifact endpoints.
Anna (oncall): pinging HF support: can you confirm if this is a targeted rate limit by org IPs or global? any ETA?
Hugging Face Support: (update) HF SRE: we're seeing elevated throttle rates due to a misconfigured CDN bucket policy; mitigation in progress. estimated mitigation timeline 30-60m. request customers to use mirror if urgent.
Miguel (sre): temporary routing rule pushed to prefer mirror for models served from hf.co for requests with model_size > 2GB. this will reduce pressure quickly. pushing to all regions now.
Customer Ops (Jane): notified impacted customers with a brief: "We're currently experiencing third-party artifact hosting rate limiting that may cause initial model loads to fail. We're actively mirroring artifacts and applying retries; no data access issue. ETA ~30-60m. We'll update when resolved." responses: a couple customers said "thanks, pls notify when stable" and one asked for a status page entry.
Anna (oncall): any downstream effects? metrics/observability?
Liz (mlops): observability: model-fetch-failures metric trending down after mirror toggle and reduced parallelism. cold-start latency median dropped from 4.2s -> 1.6s for recent invocations where mirror used. still some nodes catching up.
Miguel (sre): note: we saw a node that retried aggressively and exhausted ephemeral storage due to partial downloads; cleaned up /tmp and restarted the runtime there. added a guard to abort partial downloads earlier.
Incident Bot: action checklist created: [mirror enabled], [concurrency reduced], [retry policy updated], [HF ticket open], [customer notifications posted].
Hugging Face Support: (update) CDN team applied a fix; throttle counters are dropping. Recommend continuing to use mirror for at least 1 hour to fully drain queues.
Anna (oncall): looks like HF applied a fix. keep mirror on for 1h, then we'll roll back in a canary to hf.co only for one region. anyone want to own the rollback?
Oliver (oncall-next): I'll own the rollback canary at T+1h. will coordinate with Liz for traffic shift and with Miguel for monitoring thresholds.
Miguel (sre): postmortem notes to collect: root cause (HF CDN bucket policy), our failure modes (stampeding artifact fetches, retry policy too aggressive), mitigations we applied, and follow-ups: - add better mirror health checks and automated fallback - pre-warm popular models after deploys - make model-fetch rate limits visible on console - add backpressure in runtime model fetch queue
Anna (oncall): handing off to Oliver for overnight monitoring. leaving a short status: HF outage caused artifact hosting rate limits -> mirror fallback + concurrency limits mitigated customer impact -> HF reports fix, keep mirror on for 1h -> rollback canary owned by Oliver.
Oliver (oncall-next): acknowledged. I'll publish the short incident update to status.redwood.ai and schedule the follow-up postmortem tomorrow.
Incident Bot: oncall handoff recorded. severity: sev-2 -> monitoring. thread closed for now, will reopen on regressions. :white_check_mark:
